setup.biosManual: the BIOS screen in its settings
setup.source: Seen on a device: NetherSX2 (xyz.aethersx2.tturnip) on the RP5 console reads Android/data/xyz.aethersx2.tturnip/files/bios and booted nothing while it was empty (Droidtop/tracker#270, rig on droidtop 0.2.0-dev.1923). Flat: AetherSX2 and its builds are PCSX2 forks, whose BIOS search lists the bios folder's top only, any name (https://github.com/PCSX2/pcsx2/blob/v1.7.5000/pcsx2/ps2/BiosTools.cpp#L246, FindFiles without FILESYSTEM_FIND_RECURSIVE).
